rows.text: <<$dynslave_name>> copes well with the sweeping and wiping the dust, but when it comes to cleaning the floors and cleaning the beds, you always have to correct her.

In the blink of an eye the slave induces perfect cleanliness in the house. Everything around shines and breathes freshness. All items are laundered, ironed and neatly folded in places. Nothing to complain about, so it means that maid training is completed.

Today <<$dynslave_name>> learns the basics of first aid: CPR, chest compressions, bandaging, applying tourniquet and tires, straightening of dislocations, transportation of victims, treatment of shock states.

Under your strict guidance <<$dynslave_name>> learns about the personal assistant’s simple tasks. She calculates the household’s monthly usage of cleaning products, supplies and tools, takes stock of the reserves, places orders for all necessary purchases, and ages the invoices.

<<$dynslave_name>> does not express herself during the lesson. She listens to explanations attentively enough and tries to do everything as she was told, but results are no more than satisfactory. Must try harder.
